```{r}
library(fable)
```

Aim:

This study aims to evaluate current sortition methods and community representation processes, as well as to investigate how unobserved traits and survey non-response may affect panel representativeness. By understanding these factors, we can develop a greater understanding of existing tools and procedures, how they work, how they fall short, and what it would mean for them to be more representative.
